notes: - **osu! look: the list no longer empties as you scroll away from an open song.** With a low difficulty picked, the songs above it moved up out of the way and vanished as you scrolled up through the list (and the picked song's place was off the list's drawn part). The list draws more panels around its middle now and each fades for where it really is.

- **Your skin stays yours.** The first time, VSRG Hub takes the skin osu! has on for its interface, pointer and notes, and from then on keeps it: changing your skin in osu! no longer changes it in VSRG Hub. Options > Interface skin and the noteskins choose; "Follows osu!" there makes the interface follow osu!'s skin again, if you want that.

- **What's new, retold**: the 105 betas of 1.8.0 are now shown as the versions they amounted to, 1.7.12 to 1.7.32, each with its own notes, after TriWheel 1.7.11 and before 1.8.0. If you have one of those betas, its 1.7.x is marked as yours.

- Map preview: after a rate change (or on opening it), the jump back to where the song was happens the moment the restarted music is there, instead of after a fixed wait that let the song's start be heard.
- Map preview: opened while the song plays, it goes on from where the song was, not from the song's start.
- Back to the main menu with Esc: the music goes on as it is (the menu's song, or the one picked on song select), as osu!'s does, instead of starting over.
- Main menu: the first song really is the one you last played (on the menu nobody has joined yet, so the profile is now looked up by its id); song select then opens on it.
- Main menu music: watched while the menu is up; when nothing plays though it should (back from song select with Esc left it silent), it's started again within half a second.

- Main menu: the first song of a session is the one you last played (song select opens on it, as it always did); random ones after that. The menu's song wins over a chart left to pick again from a look switch.
- Main menu music started by its own small actor, so nothing on the menu can drop the start (coming back from song select left it silent).
- Map preview: changing the rate while it plays goes on from the same place at the new rate, instead of starting the song over.

- Play to song select: Etterna's "Loading Profiles..." moment is skipped (no band, no second's wait), and the song select really opens on the menu's song: the menu now picks songs playable in the key mode you're in (a 7K-only song couldn't be selected in 4K, so song select stayed where it was).
- 1.8.2 had the osu! and Quaver looks' main-menu settings in the wrong section of metrics.ini; put right.

- Main menu music: started a moment after the menu is up, so Etterna's own music handling can't leave it silent (the beating logo with no sound).
- Play to song select, as osu!: the menu's song keeps playing through the transition (Etterna's theme tune no longer blips in between) and song select opens on it; the osu! look leaves it playing as it is, lazer and Quaver restart it from its preview point.

- Profile page: click your name to rename the profile ("Default Profile" no more), click the picture to pick another from Etterna's Assets/Avatars folder (osu!, lazer and Quaver looks).
- Profile page: the play time tiles put the mode you're looking at first (7K play time first on the 7K tab).

**VSRG Hub 1.8.0**, the first release under its new name (TriWheel before). Everything 1.7.12 to 1.7.32 brought, in one place:

- **Three looks**: osu! stable, osu!lazer and Quaver, each with its own song select, results, main menu and options, drawn with your own skins. Switch from the options or the launcher.
- **VSRG Hub's own rankings**: every chart ranked, 4K and 7K apart, rated with Etterna's calculator. Plays are verified from their replays. The launcher's Online page has rankings (overall, by pattern, this month), profiles with a rating chart, latest plays, plays of the day, best plays and a daily challenge; the same on the web (naidez7.github.io/vsrghub). Failed daily plays go on the day's board, marked.
- **Ratings**: 4K as Etterna's player rating (the mean of the patterns); 7K the aggregate of your best plays' overall ratings, since Etterna's 7K calculator sits far under the plays. Ties on rating go by accuracy.
- **Your osu! and Quaver plays count**: the launcher reads your osu! stable, lazer and Quaver replays, judges them as Etterna would and the game rates them; new plays are picked up on their own at each start, and every rated play becomes a local score in Etterna too, with its replay.
- **Song select**: your osu!, Quaver and Qwilight songs on the wheel with thumbnails; the scoreboard in three scopes (Local, VSRG Hub, EtternaOnline), sortable by rating, accuracy, combo or date, scrolled with the wheel; a click on a VSRG Hub score opens its card; the daily challenge jumps to its chart; song select opens on the song the menu was playing.
- **Results**: the hit offsets plot with a judge switcher and column filter, VSRG Hub's verdict on the play, Watch replay.
- **The launcher**: Play with the look to start in, Games with each game's icon, What's new, Online, Options (Discord presence, keep the launcher open, ranking notices, menu background), Report a problem (a zip plus a GitHub issue), updates from GitHub, and a web link to your profile.
- **Ranking notices**: who passed you and who took a #1 from you, in the launcher, as toasts and in the game (can be turned off).
- **Discord**: what you're playing, in the game and from the launcher.
- Licensed under the GPL-3.0; built and checked on GitHub Actions from the public source.

- **A click on a VSRG Hub score opens its card** (every look): player and place, the song, accuracy and grade, judgements, combo, the play's rating in each skillset, when and where it was played, and the spread of its hit offsets.
- **The scoreboard scrolls with the mouse wheel** when more scores than fit, and has a **Sort** (Rating, Accuracy, Combo, Newest) in every look and scope; in the VSRG Hub scope each player's row is their best play by that order. Ties on rating go by accuracy.
- **Song select opens on the song the main menu was playing**, as osu!'s does; the Quaver look's menu plays a random song too; Etterna's own title music no longer starts over it.
- "Send my osu! / Quaver plays" shows its progress every 20 replays.
- lazer look: title and artist spaced out, the footer buttons' label clear of their line. osu! look: "Watch replay" on the results moves to the bottom left, off the hit offsets.

- **Your osu! / Quaver plays become local scores in Etterna too**: once rated, the launcher writes each into your Etterna profile with its replay, so it shows on the local ranking, your profile, its results, and its replay plays.
- **7K rating**: the aggregate of your best plays' overall ratings (the same aggregation Etterna uses within a skillset) instead of the mean of Etterna's 7K skillsets, which sat far under the plays. 4K is unchanged.
- **Ranking notices** can be turned off (Options). **Report a problem** opens a GitHub issue with your message filled in, to attach the zip to.
- Discord: with the launcher kept open, the game's presence replaces the launcher's while the game runs.
- lazer look: the cards' pictures cut to fit instead of squeezed, the wedge's picture slanted with the wedge.

- **osu! / Quaver plays are picked up on their own**: after the first send, the plays you make in osu! and Quaver are found each time VSRG Hub or the game starts, rated in the game and sent. "Load new plays" looks right away.
- **Daily challenge**: the day's chart is kept once picked; a failed play of it goes on the day's board, marked FAILED, counted for nothing else.
- **Results** say why a play wasn't sent (paused or invalid in Etterna, failed, autoplay, practice) instead of nothing.
- lazer look: the song list's pills sized to their words, the grade letter centred, the judge switcher on the results clear of the column buttons.
- The pictures of a converted song whose chart is gone are removed with it.

- VSRG Hub is under the **GNU GPL v3**, and every push builds the launcher on GitHub Actions from the public source (the Go source is in the repository).
- Online has a **"My profile on the web"** button, and the rankings' web address is in the README.

- **Daily challenge**: one chart a day for everyone, 4K and 7K each, picked from the charts people know; the day's board and the last days' winners, in the launcher and on the web. "Play it" takes the game to it.
- **This month's ranking**: players ranked by this month's plays only, in the rankings' dropdown (launcher and web).
- **Duplicates**: the same play sent from two games (Etterna and an osu! / Quaver replay of it) is refused.
- Web: the profile's rating graph expands to the big one; the rankings page has Latest plays / Plays of the day / Best plays / Daily challenge.

- **Admin tools** (Online page, admins only): the server at a glance, players (ban, make admin, rename), a message of the day, removing a score, duplicates.
- **Keep the launcher open while playing** (Options): it minds the game as before and is ready again once the game ends.
- **"X took #1 on Y from you"**: the ranking notices also say when someone takes the top of a chart you were first on. **Export scores** as a CSV.
- osu! look: the rate pill right of the ranking box is always there; mods have < > for the rate. lazer look: a playlists button that opens song select on your collections.

- **The lazer look, closer to lazer**: the song list's cards as lazer's carousel (title, artist, RANKED, chart and mapper, a star pill, your grade), the main menu's backdrop with lazer's triangles, and the results as lazer's: the score card in the middle, life graph, details and hit offsets on the right, the chart's ranking on the left.
- **Menu background** (Options): the song playing's picture, one random picture kept for the session, or pictures of your own.
- Fixed: the stage and receptors off to one side when the notefield is moved with a receptor size other than 100%; the scoreboard showing another scope's list after switching.

- **Who passed you**: the launcher looks at the rankings when it starts and every ten minutes while the game runs, and says when someone gets past you in 4K or 7K (or you move up), on the Online page and in the game.
- **Discord**: your activity says what you're doing in the game (picking a song, playing, results, multiplayer) and, while the launcher is open, your name and place on the rankings.
- Big backgrounds (over 2048 px) get a 1080p copy that the menus and song select load instead.

- **Rankings on the web**: rankings, profiles (pins, pictures, the rating graph), each chart's top and a page to compare two players, at naidez7.github.io/vsrghub.
- **Latest plays, three ways**: Latest plays, Plays of the day (every day's best, with a star) and Best plays, in pages of ten, with All / 4K / 7K; days counted by your PC's clock.
- **Rating over time, big**: a ⤢ button opens the graph over the whole window, with zoom, pan and a day's best plays on hover.
- **Goals** (Ctrl+G on song select), **find a player** on the Online page, an icon by the clock while plays wait to be sent, best plays per game on a profile, "someone passed you" on song select.
- **Song select loads faster**: small thumbnails instead of full backgrounds (some are 4K photos). Each game shows its own icon on the Games page.
- Sending plays no longer gets stuck; the launcher says when the server is behind; Quaver dates are read from the replay's own clock.

- **Your osu! and Quaver plays count**: "Send my osu! / Quaver plays" reads your osu! stable, osu!lazer and Quaver replays, judges them as Etterna would and the game rates them. A dot by each play says where it was played.
- **Profile pictures** (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP), **latest plays** of everyone, **a chart's top**, **rating over time** on each profile, and **pinned plays** (up to 20, in the order you like).
- **Report a problem**: the game's and VSRG Hub's logs in a zip on your desktop. "A new VSRG Hub is out" on the game's main menu when there is one.
- 7K ratings: Etterna's calculator doesn't rate Technical for 7K, so the 7K overall is the mean of the six skillsets it does rate.
- Multiplayer sign-in works under these looks; the Quaver look's mouse wheel scrolls the list without picking; the launcher updates itself even when Windows holds its old copy.

- **VSRG Hub online: accounts and rankings.** A new **Online** page in the launcher: make an account, pick your player name, sign in. **Every chart is ranked**: each play you finish is sent to VSRG Hub's rankings and your 4K and 7K ratings are worked out as Etterna does.
- **Checked scores**: each play is sent with its replay and the server works its accuracy out again. **Your older plays** can be sent too.
- **Player profiles**: anyone's place, rating by pattern and best plays. Your rating and place on the results screen and in the song select's player card.
- **VSRG Hub boards in song select**, beside Local and EtternaOnline, in every look. Forgot-your-password mail opens a page to choose a new one.
- Fixes: the main menu's circle takes clicks right away; starting a song no longer hangs on the player options hint; profiles show the right place.

- **A new launcher**: Play, Games, What's new and Options, in VSRG Hub's violet and pink. It installs itself where you choose (desktop and Start menu shortcuts), finds Etterna, and shows your games in colour when found. Options before playing: resolution, fullscreen, refresh rate, VSync, frame limits, Direct3D or OpenGL. **Updates come from GitHub.**
- **The osu! look is osu! stable**, compared screen by screen with osu! using the same skins: the main menu's cookie and purple buttons, song panels at your skin's size on osu!'s curve, the top bar as osu! draws it, osu!'s font, your player card, mod select and results like osu!'s.
- **Song select: the difficulties scroll like the songs**, and fast scrolling no longer stutters or freezes (every panel used to unpack every chart's notes). Only 4K and 7K charts are listed.
- The launcher says what's missing on PCs without the WebView2 runtime, and no longer gets stuck asking to update.

- **A new icon**: Etterna's four arrow lanes on the violet-to-pink tile, the same picture everywhere (window, taskbar, shortcut, launcher). The launcher's background: arrows falling onto their receptors.
- **Customize gameplay: Note width and Note height**, with Note size, in every look.
- **F3 / F4 change the scroll speed while playing** (in the song's first seconds), as in osu! and Quaver, and the scroll speed is shown in your game's numbers (osu!'s, lazer's or Quaver's).

- **New look: osu!lazer**, the fifth: lazer's toolbar, the main menu's button bar through the logo, the song wedge, slanted scores, the footer and lazer's results card.
- **The osu! look, redesigned**: rounded, coloured and animated like osu!; the main menu's cookie pulses to the menu music (a random song, with previous / pause / next), with its visualizer.
- **Sharper shapes** everywhere (soft one-pixel edges), **smoother song select** (the list glides, pictures fade over each other), the osu! look's song panels use your skin's art, the results count up.
- **Menus as smooth as your monitor**: the themes' moving parts ran at 60 per second whatever the frame rate; the beat is right on the music's.
- First start picks the skins you use in osu!. Fixed: a crash after opening an online score whose replay couldn't be sent; a replay's noteskin staying as your pick; switching looks changing your 4K notes.

- **The launcher**: opening vsrghub.exe (or the new desktop shortcut) shows a window with Play, the look to start in and update checks.
- **Online rankings in song select** (osu! and Quaver looks): the ranking box switches between Local and EtternaOnline's leaderboard for the chart. Click an online score to see it, right click to watch its replay.
- **Background dim and blur** options for song select; **sharper text** (the fonts redrawn at a higher resolution); an **icon** for the program, the launcher and the game window.
- Fixed: grades on the song wheel follow your accuracy on the timing you played; the osu! options' E section scrolls again.

- **Easy updates**: your songs, settings and layouts live in Etterna's `Save/VSRGHub`, so a new version never converts your library again.
- **Profile: Local / Online**: your EtternaOnline profile (ratings, world and country rank, top, recent and most played) and a Rankings tab with the world's and your country's players. **Log in to EtternaOnline from any look.**
- **Customize gameplay: a Lighting tab**, receptors over or under the notes, the lane cover's border; **combo skin** in any skin's digits; **Quaver's custom judgement windows** (Peaceful to Impossible and your own).
- **Results and scoreboards go by the timing you played with**: osu!'s letters in the osu! look, Quaver's in the Quaver look, Etterna's grade beside; the big accuracy on your timing, other judges in the tooltip.
- Song select: search waits until you stop typing and the results slide in; difficulties stay put when you click one; the list no longer wraps round with few songs.
- Fixed: Ctrl+O and typing not working in Til' Death and Rebirth after the osu! or Quaver look.

- **Your profile page, in every look**: click your player card (osu!), PROFILE (Quaver), or your profile corner in Til' Death and Rebirth. A full page in the look's own style: ratings per skillset, play time, plays, grades, top, recent and most played.
- **Every difficulty of a song in the osu! and Quaver looks**: the selected song opens up and lists all its charts (name, keys, length, notes, main pattern, MSD at your rate, your best).
- **osu!, Quaver and Qwilight are found on any drive** (where their installers put them, their usual folders, or a folder at the top of a drive); rate edits are found by the song's name.
- The combo shows with skins that put it off the screen.

- **Til' Death and Rebirth: Customize Gameplay with a panel** in their own colours, with the noteskin settings of the osu! and Quaver looks (note spacing and size, receptor offset and size, stage hint, LN tail).
- **The lane cover, in every look**: off, sudden or hidden, with its height, opacity and colour; skins with a mania-stage-bottom keep their art as a fourth choice.
- **A new Customize gameplay panel in the osu! and Quaver looks**, each in its look's style: Notefield, Notes, Receptors, Lane cover and HUD tabs, a slider with - / + for every value.
- Lane flash on misses is off by default (an option turns it on); Ctrl+O never turns Etterna's practice mode on by itself any more.

- **New name: VSRG Hub.** The title screen, the looks ("VSRG Hub osu!" / "VSRG Hub Quaver"), the program (VSRGHub/vsrghub.exe) and this page. Coming from TriWheel, the first launch moves your converted song library over.
- **Only Etterna is needed.** osu!, Quaver and Qwilight are optional: whichever you have adds its songs and skins, the ones you don't have are left out.

- **Failing ends the play at once** (the fade used to keep judging notes for two seconds); the pause menu opens instantly.
- **No more 1-pixel lines around skin pictures** and no coloured lines beside long notes: pictures whose size isn't a power of two are handled as Etterna needs; very long LNs no longer show a cut in the middle.
- **Customize gameplay: Column spacing, Note spacing, Note size, Stage hint offset and height**, kept per noteskin, 4K and 7K apart; the stage hint is one picture across the whole stage, as osu! and Quaver draw it.
- Map preview: long notes come in whole from the top of the box.
- Layout polish in the osu! and Quaver looks (song select panels, options, mods, results, pause menu), and Til' Death / Rebirth menus answer the keys again after a look switch.

- **Frosted glass in the osu! look**: bars, panels, lists, dialogs and the options show the background blurred through a grey tint (OpenGL).
- **Til' Death and Rebirth get the other looks' features** in their Ctrl+O menu: timing (Etterna judge or osu! OD), pointer and pointer size, play time per key mode.
- **Keybinds, in every look** (Ctrl+K): every key worth knowing, by category, and a way to change VSRG Hub's shortcuts and Etterna's note keys there.
- **Pause** goes on from where the notes stopped, without jumping; **accuracy** can go below 0% as in Etterna, with a hover window showing the play at J4 to Justice and OD 6 to 10; played on an osu! OD, the accuracy is osu!mania's.
- Customize gameplay: long note tail height and offset, the error bar's background opacity; Space skips a long intro; Mirror, Full LN and Inverse show in the map preview.
- Random song is Ctrl+R; the rate keys change the rate on song select; many small fixes in the osu! and Quaver looks (clicks through panels, Esc in dropdowns, skin digits cut by a big ScoreOverlap).

- **Quaver skins in the osu! look**: playing with any Quaver skin's notes (e.g. Quaver maria), the combo, judgements and score / accuracy use that skin's own pictures from its Judgements and Numbers folders (shared by 4K and 7K, as in Quaver) at the sizes its skin.ini sets for the mode you play; a Quaver skin without its own digits shows plain numbers. The combo used to be missing.
- **See-through grey in the osu! look**, layered by what should stand out: background and bars lightest, panels more solid, and what opens on top (options, lists, dropdowns, volume) nearly solid. The Quaver look keeps Quaver's own colours.
- **Song select (osu! look)**: pattern ratings as cards with a bar each, local ranking on grey with the grade colour from the left, failed plays shown as a grey F instead of a D, a small grade badge on played maps in the wheel (the odd "D" squares are gone), and a dark see-through layer under the wheel panels so text reads over bright backgrounds.
- **No more stray broken lines** on the HUD with skins that pad their score digits and use a huge ScoreOverlap: score and accuracy (with its %) now sit together.
- **Play time per key mode**: the player card shows your play time in the mode you are in (4K or 7K); the profile panel lists 4K, 7K and total.
- **Watch replays** in the osu! and Quaver looks: "Watch replay" on the results, or right click a score on song select. Your mods, noteskin and rate come back afterwards.
- **Practice mode** like Etterna's (PR mod in the osu! look, PRACTICE in Quaver's Modifiers, or Tab from the map preview): a density bar along the bottom to jump through the song, loop a part (right click start / end, Backspace to go back) and pause with Esc. Nothing is scored.
- **Skip long intros** with Space, as in osu! and Quaver ("Press Space to skip" shows while you can; a 7K key on Space plays normally after).
- **Options for any game** (Ctrl+O): display mode, resolution, VSync, FPS counter, background dim, FPS limits for menus and playing, limit mode, slowing down when the game isn't in front, volumes and audio offset. Scroll speed can be typed; Quaver-look rows have < > to lower values.
- **Results**: MA and PA ratios, clear type, max combo, holds, mines, judge and the score's ratings in both looks. Misses on the hit plot are faint lines like Etterna's. New option "7K thumb on the middle key" (right by default: hands 3 + 4) for the left / right hand stats.
- **Previews**: in the map preview a long note's head stays on the receptor while it goes by; changing the noteskin updates the open preview; the noteskin lists show the noteskin under the cursor playing the selected song; the preview's graph side has a see-through grey panel. Etterna's Player Options show the noteskin in a small playfield on the left that never runs over the options.
- **Customize gameplay**: stretch receptors and any part (width / height), lane cover height, opacity and on / off, hidden parts really hide, notefield / receptor / lane cover settings saved per noteskin. Quaver no longer lists the hit error bar twice.
- Alt + wheel changes the volume while the wheel turns, and the wheel no longer changes the volume without Alt after leaving a song.
- Leaving a score's results puts your own rate back.

- **Quaver skins in the osu! look**: playing with a Quaver skin's notes (e.g. Quaver maria), the combo, judgements and score / accuracy use that skin's own digits and pictures at its sizes, as in the Quaver look (the combo used to be missing).

- **Skip long intros** with Space, as in osu! and Quaver ("Press Space to skip" shows while you can; a 7K key on Space plays normally after).
- **Options for any game** (Ctrl+O): display mode, resolution, VSync, FPS counter, background dim, FPS limits for menus and playing, limit mode, slowing down when the game isn't in front, volumes and audio offset. Scroll speed can be typed; Quaver-look rows have < > to lower values.
- **Results**: MA and PA ratios, clear type, max combo, holds, mines, judge and the score's ratings in both looks. Misses on the hit plot are faint lines like Etterna's. New option "7K thumb on the middle key" (right by default: hands 3 + 4) for the left / right hand stats.
- **Previews**: in the map preview a long note's head stays on the receptor while it goes by; changing the noteskin updates the open preview; the noteskin lists show the noteskin under the cursor playing the selected song; the preview's graph side has a see-through grey panel. Etterna's Player Options show the noteskin in a small playfield on the left that never runs over the options.
- **Customize gameplay**: stretch receptors and any part (width / height), lane cover height, opacity and on / off, hidden parts really hide, notefield / receptor / lane cover settings saved per noteskin. Quaver no longer lists the hit error bar twice.
- Alt + wheel changes the volume while the wheel turns, and the wheel no longer changes the volume without Alt after leaving a song.
- Leaving a score's results puts your own rate back.

- osu! long notes end the way they do in osu!:
  - The hold images are read from skin.ini as osu! reads them (NoteImage#H / #L / #T, the first [Mania] section for each key count).
  - Skins that draw the hold's end at the top of a very tall body image (like nego_dnik edit) now show that rounded end, at osu!'s size, instead of ending flat. Etterna noteskins are unchanged.
- Quaver look:
  - View Map: clicking anywhere on the graph jumps there (before, anything past the middle sent the song back to the middle). The osu! look's Map Preview too.
  - Enter plays the song after you click it or search for it.
  - Esc closes Modifiers, View Map or Profile without leaving song select.
  - Etterna's own "Customize Gameplay" player option now opens the editor for the next song (once).
- osu! look:
  - The accuracy's % is no longer cut off (skins whose % is wider than their digits, like Low Zenith).
  - Without skin art, the back / mode / mods / random / options buttons are flat labels on the bottom bar that light up under the mouse (F1 / F2 / F3 shown, F2 is random).
- Starting the game or switching looks shows that look's splash (osu!'s cookie, Quaver's logo) instead of "Til Death".
- Switching looks keeps your key mode, the selected chart and your noteskin, and the osu! and Quaver looks open straight on song select.
- New Cursor option with a preview: the look's own, Etterna's, Quaver's or the cursor of any of your osu! skins (@2x handled as in osu!), plus Cursor size. Used in all four looks.

- Quaver skins look the way they do in Quaver:
  - Skins downloaded from the Steam Workshop are now available as noteskins too, not only the ones in Quaver's Skins folder.
  - Notes coloured by beat snap, from separate pictures or from a sprite sheet (before, skins that use a sheet were left out).
  - Notes and receptors turned per column, the gap between columns (NotePadding) and note height (WidthForNoteHeightScale).
  - Settings a skin leaves out come from its DefaultSkin (Bar, Arrow or Circle), as in Quaver.
  - Hold ends are centred on the hold's end with the body under them, so long notes no longer show a gap.
  - Receptors are drawn in front of the notes when the skin asks for it.
  - Hit lighting, hold lighting and column lighting.
- Quaver look: playing with a Quaver skin's notes, the judgements, score and combo digits and health bar come from that skin, at its sizes.
- osu! skins: columns of different widths and the gaps between columns (ColumnWidth / ColumnSpacing lists) are kept, and the LightingN / LightingL lighting is drawn over the hit line.

- Fixed: with an osu! skin that has both 4K and 7K notes, the columns took the other key mode's width, so notes and keys overlapped (or had gaps). Each mode now uses its own column width.
- Lane cover: an osu! skin's mania-stage-bottom is drawn as osu! draws it, over the notes. In Customize gameplay pick "Lane cover" and drag it up or down to set how much it covers (the wheel sizes it). Without that art there's a plain lane cover you can turn on there. Stage art follows the skin.ini's 7K section in 7K.
- osu! look: the mode / mods / random / options buttons, the play cookie and the highlights take your interface skin's own colour instead of osu!'s strong pink; Options > Interface colour picks another (osu! pink among them).
- osu! look: click your player card for your profile (ratings per skillset, plays, hits, play time); F3 can make a new playlist with the selected chart; Ctrl+O works on the results screen; Reset All Mods also puts the rate back to 1.0x.
- Quaver look: right click a map for Quaver's map menu (play, favourite, add to a playlist, new playlist, view map); DOWNLOAD in the top bar opens the pack downloader; quitting asks first.
- Til' Death and Rebirth: the Ctrl+O menu can filter song select by an osu! collection, an Etterna playlist or a pattern type; Alt + mouse wheel changes the volume; TriWheel's noteskins fit those themes' columns.
- Fixed: the selected part in Customize gameplay can be dragged from anywhere inside it; scores below 0 are written properly; menus no longer show an empty playlist name.

- Pausing, if you want it: turn "Pausing" on in the options of any look (or press Ctrl+P on the main menu, song select or results). Then Esc pauses a song as in osu!, with Continue, Retry and Quit (your osu! skin's pause art when it has some) and a 3-2-1 count before the song goes on. Off, Esc leaves the song as in Etterna.
- After a paused play, the results say "Pauses: N" in green with a green line on the hit-offset plot where you paused, as in Quaver (in all four looks). The score is saved but marked invalid, like Etterna's "invalidate score": it doesn't count for your rating and EtternaOnline gets it as invalid. The score lists mark it "invalid".
- Long notes: the hold's body now starts inside the head and is drawn behind it, as in osu!, in both scroll directions.
- The mouse pointer is your interface skin's cursor in the osu! and Quaver looks (cursor.png with its middle and trail, turning and growing on click as the skin says), and Etterna's own pointer in Til' Death and Rebirth. It hides while you play.
- osu! look runs smoother: song select no longer reloads thumbnails, grade icons and number glyphs over and over, and big packs no longer stall the wheel while counting their songs.
- osu! mod select: mod icons fit their buttons, mods without a skin icon get a lettered tile, and the active mods sit above the bottom bar.
- osu! results: every hit count has its caption (MAX / 300 / 200 / 100 / 50 / MISS).
- Results in both looks: stepping the judge with < > no longer shows the judge you played twice.
- Quaver look: the options panel shows which row the keyboard is on; the key mode on results no longer looks like a second tab.
- Options: on the main menu the Notes rows show your saved noteskins, and a noteskin picked there (or for the other key mode) is the one you play with.
- Esc closes only the list you're in, not the options panel behind it.

- Fixed: the menus on song select (Group by, Sort by, Mode, the options panel and its lists) opened invisibly, and the game's cursor stayed in the corner. Clicking the buttons of a dialog (like the exit question) works again.
- Alt + mouse wheel changes the volume on song select before the wheel moves.
- Customize gameplay: click a part to pick it, then drag it or use the mouse wheel; the wheel only sizes the picked part, right click lets go, and the part under the mouse is outlined.
- osu! look: "Map Preview" in the "Local Ranking" box shows the chart scrolling with the song, the difficulty graph to click and Tab to play from there, like Quaver's View Map. Notes now stay inside the preview box in both looks, and the preview covers the whole song.
- Clicking one of your local scores (osu! look) opens its results.
- Keys (4K / 7K) in the options opens a small list instead of switching on a click.
- Searching updates each pack's song count to the songs that match.
- osu! results: the hit art beside each count is sized to fit, and counts no longer use the skin's "x" glyph (some skins draw it as "Score").
- Hold ends: the skin's end image now sits inside the hold, turned the way osu! (or Quaver) turns it, so round skins end their long notes with a round cap. Skins without a tail image use the head image, as osu! does.
- Quaver skins now also give 4K noteskins (sized by their ColumnSize).
- Difficulties of one map set are one song again when their timing lines differ only slightly (Til' Death and the other looks show them as one song with its charts).
- Dan Overlay keeps working in the osu! and Quaver looks.
- Til' Death: the chart preview is smaller; Customize Gameplay reminds you that R + Up / Down moves the hit position. Player options' noteskin preview shows 7 columns in 7K, and the osu! OD row has its name.

- Customize gameplay (Options > Customize gameplay, or Etterna's Customize Gameplay option): the chart plays on autoplay with an editor over it, for 4K and 7K separately. Drag any part (judgment, combo, score, accuracy, health bar, mods, hit error bar, time) to move it, mouse wheel to resize; drag the notefield for its position and hit position. Also notefield size, column width, receptor offset and size, and Etterna's extra parts (error bar, progress bar, judgment counter, mean, NPS, pace).
- Results show Etterna's hit-offset plot in both looks: every hit and miss across the chart, judge windows, mean / SD / largest / combo breaks per hand, a column filter (click or 1-7, H for hands) to see which finger missed where, Wife% rescored from J4 to Justice, and the score so far when you hover.
- Quaver's Full LN and Inverse mods (osu!lazer's Invert), converted the way Quaver does it. The converted chart is written once to Songs/TriWheel Mods and has its own MSD and scores.
- Judge or osu! OD: pick Etterna's judge (J4 to Justice) or osu!'s OD 0-10, in the options and Etterna's Player Options; using one turns the other off.
- Group by Pattern (Stream, Jumpstream, Handstream, Stamina, JackSpeed, Chordjack, Technical); a chart can be in more than one.
- Quaver View Map: the graph shows how hard each part is on the MSD scale with a line following the song; click it to jump there; Tab plays the chart from that point. The preview now covers the whole song there.
- Alt + mouse wheel changes the volume on every screen; right click on an empty part of song select pauses the preview.
- 4K / 7K from a menu: the Keys row in the options and the mode button / MODE dropdown.
- 7K bar skins draw their stage hint line at the hit position; other skins keep their 7K keys.
- osu! look: the song wheel, buttons and panels are drawn by TriWheel instead of skin art with osu!-only text; the skin still gives the backgrounds, main menu background, mod icons and gameplay. A changed interface skin applies with Enter or the Apply button.
- Fixed: arrow keys and the mouse wheel move the Quaver song list again.
- Fixed: buttons in dialogs (like the exit question) can be clicked again.

- Fixed: long notes were drawn wrong with many osu! skins: when Etterna couldn't load the skin's long-note body, the note image was repeated along the hold. TriWheel now converts the skin's own body so Etterna can load it and stretches it over the hold, as osu! does.
- Fixed: in downscroll the long-note head and end cap were swapped (the head showed at the top of the hold). Heads now sit at the start, end caps at the end, for osu! and Quaver skins, in 4K and 7K.
- Faster start: the converted long-note bodies are kept and only redone when the skin's file changes.
- Quaver look: View Map shows the chart scrolling inside its box (it spilled out before), and difficulty numbers use Quaver's own colours (cyan, green, light blue, yellow, red, pink, violet, grey-white from 50).
- Quaver look: the Mode drop-down switches between 4 and 7 keys without leaving the theme, and you land back on song select.
- osu! look: the mode button opens osu!'s mode list (osu!mania 4K / 7K) instead of Etterna's game screen.
- osu! and Quaver looks: start typing anywhere on song select to search, as in osu! and Quaver.
- osu! look: with skins whose bottom-bar art covers the whole screen (osu!faithful), the top bar (Group, Sort, search) is no longer hidden.
- Fixed: the 7K noteskin you picked could fall back to Etterna's default after going back to the main menu.
- Fixed: Ctrl+O no longer leaves practice mode switched on, and Enter plays the selected song again after using the options.
- The selected row in the options panel is easier to see.
